proof_body:
by
  intro G _ H K
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨L, hL⟩
    by_contra hcon
    rw [not_or] at hcon
    obtain ⟨h1, h2⟩ := hcon
    obtain ⟨a, haH, haK⟩ := SetLike.not_le_iff_exists.mp h1
    obtain ⟨b, hbK, hbH⟩ := SetLike.not_le_iff_exists.mp h2
    have haL : a ∈ L := by
      have : a ∈ (L : Set G) := by
        rw [hL]
        exact Or.inl haH
      exact this
    have hbL : b ∈ L := by
      have : b ∈ (L : Set G) := by
        rw [hL]
        exact Or.inr hbK
      exact this
    have hab : a * b ∈ (L : Set G) := L.mul_mem haL hbL
    rw [hL] at hab
    rcases hab with h | h
    · exact hbH (by simpa using H.mul_mem (H.inv_mem haH) h)
    · exact haK (by simpa using K.mul_mem h (K.inv_mem hbK))
  · rintro (h | h)
    · exact ⟨K, (Set.union_eq_self_of_subset_left (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.mpr h)).symm⟩
    · exact ⟨H, (Set.union_eq_self_of_subset_right (SetLike.coe_subset_coe.mpr h)).symm⟩
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (H K : Subgroup G), (∃ L : Subgroup G, (L : Set G) = (H : Set G) ∪ (K : Set G)) ↔ (H ≤ K ∨ K ≤ H)
